install_manifm_package: install the manifm python package using pip install -e . from the project root
build_manifm_sdist: build a source distribution of the manifm package using python setup.py sdist
review_setup_config: review the setuptools setup configuration for the manifm package metadata and package discovery
summarize_setup_py: summarize the setup.py file which configures the manifm package for flow matching on manifolds
refactor_setup_py: refactor the setup.py to use pyproject.toml instead of setuptools.setup for modern packaging
